_comment: Databricks Jobs API definition for the config-driven ingestion pipeline.
Or via the Databricks UI: Workflows → Create Job → Import JSON.
BEFORE IMPORTING — update the following placeholders:
in list_active_sources.py and matched against ingestion_config.pipeline_name.
Only rows with matching pipeline_name are ingested in this job run.
Table name overrides (leave blank to use framework defaults from config_manager.py):
delta_layer is now read from ingestion_config.delta_layer — not a job parameter.
landing_volume_path is a job parameter — set it to your S3/Volume base path.
name: generic_source_to_bronze_ingestion

parameters.name: source_type_filter
parameters.description: Source type filter (e.g. POSTGRES). Leave blank for all.

parameters.name: source_system_id
parameters.description: Filter by source_system_id (integer). Leave blank for all.

parameters.name: source_name
parameters.description: Filter by source system name (e.g. PG_TEST_RDS). Leave blank for all.

parameters.name: landing_volume_path
parameters.description: Base S3/Volume path for raw landing (e.g. s3://pfl-raw/landing). Leave blank to skip landing write.

tasks._comment: Task 1: query ingestion_config filtered by pipeline_name (auto-detected as this Job's name) and publish ingestion_object_ids as a task value
Task 2: fan-out — one notebook run per ingestion_object_id from Task 1. delta_layer comes from ingestion_config.delta_layer (not a parameter here).
